payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in NMT systems, particularly in low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods, such as the mix-source method, utilize monolingual data to improve bilingual training data.
Back Translation is used to create synthetic parallel data by translating monolingual data into the source language.
Combining original bilingual data with synthetic data helps alleviate data sparsity in NMT systems.
Appending language tags to sentences aids the NMT in modeling language information effectively in low-resourced scenarios.
